answer: A bond-gate plus a one-account-per-identity cap does the job. Each agent must lock a refundable stake before it may act, and a new identity cannot be minted at will: a fresh actor enters only through a verified inlet tied to one person or one attested device. So each extra Sybil account costs another full stake plus a per-epoch fee, while the extra throughput it buys stays flat. One cheater is slashed and the whole cluster loses admission, so cost scales with no gain. Honest agents pay a deposit they can withdraw, and the fable that fake wallets are cheap dies on the horizon of real burn.
